title: Zesty Malaysian Chickpea Wrap
description: A sweet and tangy chickpea wrap with aromatic Malaysian flavors, perfect for a hangover cure and diabetic-friendly meal.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a medium skillet over medium heat until melted.
Add the minced garlic and ground ginger, sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in the tamarind paste, soy sauce, and a pinch of salt, cooking for another minute.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Add the drained chickpeas and lime juice, and cook for 8-10 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly.
Season with black pepper, tasting and adjusting the seasoning if needed.
Warm the ti leaf wraps in a dry pan or microwave for 20 seconds to make them pliable.
Spoon the chickpea filling onto each wrap, top with fresh cilantro leaves.
Fold the wrap over the filling, roll tightly, and serve immediately.
